name: A new Merchant Caller in Merchant Call cancels the old call and is emailed
description:
Objective: A new Merchant Caller in Merchant Call cancels the old call and is emailed.
Preconditions: Open Application editing ownership with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Application editing ownership.
2. A new Merchant Caller in Merchant Call cancels the old call and is emailed.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: The behavior named in the scenario is observed and its assertions pass.
